system.description:
INVESTED SOUL

Level 7; Price 3,000 gp; Usage inscribed onto armour; Activate Reaction; Trigger the wielder takes a critical hit; Frequency 1/day

This rune allows you to lessen the damage from the most lethal of attacks.

You negate the additional HP damage inflicted by the critical hit and are immediately healed an amount of HP equal to half of this amount (round up).

On the sheet: Asked of the wearer's player when a critical hit lands, before the damage is rolled (a reaction, once a day): the critical's extra dice are not dealt, and half of what they rolled is healed, rounded up.
